# Hierarchical PLS_DA Evaluation
# Evaluation on F1-Score and MCC on Overall
```{r}
## Import all results
initial_data <- list(
    "binary_1000" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/plsda_1000_results.csv"),
    "binary_1250" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/plsda_1250_results.csv"),
    "weighted_1000" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/weighted_plsda_1000_results.csv"),
    "weighted_1250" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/weighted_plsda_1250_results.csv")
)

# remove all column except 1 - 5 and 15
data <- lapply(initial_data, function(df) df[, c(1:5, 16,17)])

# remove Total_DON data on 1000 dataframes
data$binary_1000 <- data$binary_1000[data$binary_1000$Target_toxin != "Total_DON", ]
data$weighted_1000 <- data$weighted_1000[data$weighted_1000$Target_toxin != "Total_DON", ]

# add details about the sample_weight
data$binary_1000$Sample_weight <- "None"
data$binary_1250$Sample_weight <- "None"
data$weighted_1000$Sample_weight <- "Weighted"
data$weighted_1250$Sample_weight <- "Weighted"

# combine all dataframes into one
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, data)

# remove the second derivative data
combined_data <- combined_data[combined_data$Preprocessing != "2nd_Der", ]

# except F1_Score and MCCtransform all to factor
combined_data[c(1:5, 8)] <- lapply(combined_data[c(1:5, 8)], as.factor)
str(combined_data)

#transform MCC using Fisher's z transformation
combined_data$MCC_z <- atanh(combined_data$MCC)

#rename the columns
library(dplyr)
lme_data <- combined_data %>%
 rename(
   Grinding = Sample_source,
   Toxin = Target_toxin,
   Weighting = Sample_weight
 )
```

## Analysis using Linear mixed-effects
This experiment is performed using Full Factorial Design with 5 factors: Sample_weight, Target_toxin, Preprocessing, Variable_Selection and Sample_weight.

```{r}
#### Data analysis for MCC_z
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
# # Fit the linear mixed-effects model until three-way interaction
model_mcc <- lmer(MCC_z ~ (Grinding + Weighting + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection )^2 + (1|Split), data = lme_data)
anova(model_mcc)
summary(model_mcc)
#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_mcc <- emmeans(model_mcc, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Weighting)
mcc_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_mcc$emmeans)
mcc_pipelines_df <- mcc_pipelines_df[order(-mcc_pipelines_df$emmean), ]


# Data analysis for F1_Score
# Because F1_Score always between 0 and 1, therefore we cannot use lmer, we need to use glmmTMB with beta distribution
library(glmmTMB)
model_f1 <- glmmTMB(F1_score ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting)^2 + (1|Split), data = lme_data, family = ordbeta(link = "logit"))
library(car)
Anova(model_f1, type = "III")
summary(model_f1)
# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_f1)
r2(model_f1)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_f1 <- emmeans(model_f1, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Weighting, type = "response")
f1_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_f1$emmeans)
f1_pipelines_df <- f1_pipelines_df[order(-f1_pipelines_df$response), ]

```

## Evaluation using downsampling samples

```{r}
## Import all results
ds_data <- list(
    "binary_1000" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "binary_1250" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/plsda_1250_all.csv"),
    "weighted_1000" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/weighted_plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "weighted_1250" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/weighted_plsda_1250_all.csv")
)

# remove all column except 1 - 5 and 15
ds_data_cut <- lapply(ds_data, function(df) df[, c(1:5, 9:12, 16,17)])

# add details about the sample_weight
ds_data_cut$binary_1000$Sample_weight <- "None"
ds_data_cut$binary_1250$Sample_weight <- "None"
ds_data_cut$weighted_1000$Sample_weight <- "Weighted"
ds_data_cut$weighted_1250$Sample_weight <- "Weighted"

# combine all dataframes into one
combined_ds_data <- do.call(rbind, ds_data_cut)

# except F1_Score and MCCtransform all to factor
combined_ds_data[c(1:5, 12)] <- lapply(combined_ds_data[c(1:5, 12)], as.factor)
str(combined_ds_data)

#transform MCC using Fisher's z transformation
combined_ds_data$MCC_z <- atanh(combined_ds_data$MCC)
combined_ds_data$TPR <- combined_ds_data$TP / (combined_ds_data$TP + combined_ds_data$FN)
combined_ds_data$TNR <- combined_ds_data$TN / (combined_ds_data$TN + combined_ds_data$FP)

#rename the columns
library(dplyr)
lme_ds_data <- combined_ds_data %>%
 rename(
   Grinding = Sample_source,
   Toxin = Target_toxin,
   Weighting = Sample_weight
 )
```

## Plot the TPR and TNR of the downsampling data

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
density_plot <- function(data, var, color, label, title){
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = var, fill = color)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5)) +
    labs(title = title, x = label, fill = color) +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank())
  return(plot)
}

# Plot TPR
tp_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TPR, color = "TPR", label = "True Positive Rate", title = "TPR of all pipelines") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("TPR" = "#DB1A1A"))
tp_weighting_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TPR, lme_ds_data$Weighting, label = "True Positive Rate", title = "Effect of Weighting")
tp_toxin_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TPR, lme_ds_data$Toxin, label = "True Positive Rate", title = "Effect of Toxin")
tp_grinding_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TPR, lme_ds_data$Grinding, label = "True Positive Rate", title = "Effect of Grinding")
tp_preprocessing_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TPR, lme_ds_data$Preprocessing, label = "True Positive Rate", title = "Effect of Preprocessing")
tp_variable_selection_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TPR, lme_ds_data$Variable_Selection, label = "True Positive Rate", title = "Effect of Variable Selection")

# Plot TNR
tn_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TNR, color = "TNR", label = "True Negative Rate", title = "TNR of all pipelines") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("TNR" = "#2FA4D7"))
tn_weighting_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TNR, lme_ds_data$Weighting, label = "True Negative Rate", title = NULL)
tn_toxin_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TNR, lme_ds_data$Toxin, label = "True Negative Rate", title = NULL)
tn_grinding_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TNR, lme_ds_data$Grinding, label = "True Negative Rate", title = NULL)
tn_preprocessing_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TNR, lme_ds_data$Preprocessing, label = "True Negative Rate", title = NULL)
tn_variable_selection_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$TNR, lme_ds_data$Variable_Selection, label = "True Negative Rate", title = NULL)

# Arrange the plots in a grid
tp_tn <- ggarrange(tp_plot, tn_plot, ncol = 2, nrow = 1)
ggsave("./Austrian/figures/downsampling_tpr_tnr_density_plots_overall.svg", tp_tn, width = 12, height = 6)
tpr_tnr <- ggarrange(tp_weighting_plot, tp_toxin_plot, tp_grinding_plot, tp_preprocessing_plot, tp_variable_selection_plot,
          tn_weighting_plot, tn_toxin_plot, tn_grinding_plot, tn_preprocessing_plot, tn_variable_selection_plot,
          ncol = 5, nrow = 2)
ggsave("./Austrian/figures/downsampling_tpr_tnr_density_plots.svg", tpr_tnr, width = 20, height = 8)


## Plot the MCC
mcc_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$MCC, color = "MCC", label = "MCC", title = "MCC of all pipelines") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("MCC" = "#1A9BDB"))
mcc_weighting_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$MCC, lme_ds_data$Weighting, label = "MCC", title = "Effect of Weighting")
mcc_toxin_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$MCC, lme_ds_data$Toxin, label = "MCC", title = "Effect of Toxin")
mcc_grinding_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$MCC, lme_ds_data$Grinding, label = "MCC", title = "Effect of Grinding")
mcc_preprocessing_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$MCC, lme_ds_data$Preprocessing, label = "MCC", title = "Effect of Preprocessing")
mcc_variable_selection_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$MCC, lme_ds_data$Variable_Selection, label = "MCC", title = "Effect of Variable Selection")
mcc_plots <- ggarrange(mcc_plot, mcc_weighting_plot, mcc_toxin_plot, mcc_grinding_plot, mcc_preprocessing_plot, mcc_variable_selection_plot,
          ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
ggsave("./Austrian/figures/downsampling_mcc_density_plots.svg", mcc_plots, width = 12, height = 6)

## Plot the F1_Score
f1_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$F1_score, color = "F1_Score", label = "F1 Score", title = "F1 Score of all pipelines") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F1_Score" = "#DBA41A")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))

f1_weighting_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$F1_score, lme_ds_data$Weighting, label = "F1 Score", title = "Effect of Weighting") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))
f1_toxin_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$F1_score, lme_ds_data$Toxin, label = "F1 Score", title = "Effect of Toxin") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))
f1_grinding_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$F1_score, lme_ds_data$Grinding, label = "F1 Score", title = "Effect of Grinding") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))
f1_preprocessing_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$F1_score, lme_ds_data$Preprocessing, label = "F1 Score", title = "Effect of Preprocessing") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))
f1_variable_selection_plot <- density_plot(lme_ds_data, lme_ds_data$F1_score, lme_ds_data$Variable_Selection, label = "F1 Score", title = "Effect of Variable Selection") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))
f1_plots <- ggarrange(f1_plot, f1_weighting_plot, f1_toxin_plot, f1_grinding_plot, f1_preprocessing_plot, f1_variable_selection_plot,
          ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
ggsave("./Austrian/figures/downsampling_f1_density_plots.svg", f1_plots, width = 12, height = 6)
```

# Fit the linear mixed-effects model until three-way interaction

```{r}
#### Data analysis for MCC_z
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
# # Fit the linear mixed-effects model until three-way interaction
model_ds_mcc <- lmer(MCC_z ~ (Grinding + Weighting + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection)^3 + (1|Split), data = lme_ds_data)
anova(model_ds_mcc)
summary(model_ds_mcc)

# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_ds_mcc)
r2(model_ds_mcc)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_ds_mcc <- emmeans(model_ds_mcc, pairwise ~ Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting)
mcc_ds_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_ds_mcc$emmeans)
mcc_ds_pipelines_df <- mcc_ds_pipelines_df[order(-mcc_ds_pipelines_df$emmean), ]


# Data analysis for F1_Score
# Because F1_Score always between 0 and 1, therefore we cannot use lmer, we need to use glmmTMB with beta distribution
library(glmmTMB)
model_f1 <- lmer(F1_score ~ Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting + (1|Split), data = lme_ds_data)
anova(model_f1)
summary(model_f1)
# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_f1)
r2(model_f1)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_f1 <- emmeans(model_f1, pairwise ~ Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting, type = "response")
f1_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_f1$emmeans)
f1_pipelines_df <- f1_pipelines_df[order(-f1_pipelines_df$emmean), ]

## Data analysis for TPR
model_tpr <- lmer(TPR ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting)^2 + (1|Split), data = lme_ds_data)
anova(model_tpr)
summary(model_tpr)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_tpr <- emmeans(model_tpr, pairwise ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting)^3)
tpr_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_tpr$emmeans)
tpr_pipelines_df <- tpr_pipelines_df[order(-tpr_pipelines_df$emmean), ]

```

## Plotting on MCC

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Calculate the means and standard errors for your groups
plot_data <- lme_ds_data %>%
  group_by(Toxin, Weighting) %>%
  summarize(mean_MCC = mean(MCC, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(MCC, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = 'drop')

# 2. Plot the results
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Toxin, y = mean_MCC, color = Weighting, group = Weighting)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_MCC - se, ymax = mean_MCC + se), width = 0.1) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Interaction Plot: Toxin vs. Weighting",
       x = "Toxin Type",
       y = "Mean MCC Score",
       color = "Weighting")
```

# PLS-DA with 780 nm to 2500 nm

```{r}
## Import all results
data_780 <- list(
    "binary_1000" = read.csv("./Austrian/results/780/plsda_1000_all.csv"),

data_780_cut$weighted_1250$Sample_weight <- "Weighted"

# combine all dataframes into one
combined_780_data <- do.call(rbind, data_780_cut)

# except F1_Score and MCCtransform all to factor
combined_780_data[c(1:5, 8)] <- lapply(combined_780_data[c(1:5, 8)], as.factor)
str(combined_780_data)

#transform MCC using Fisher's z transformation
combined_780_data$MCC_z <- atanh(combined_780_data$MCC)

#rename the columns
library(dplyr)
lme_780_data <- combined_780_data %>%
 rename(
   Grinding = Sample_source,
   Toxin = Target_toxin,
   Weighting = Sample_weight
 )

#### Data analysis for MCC_z
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
# # Fit the linear mixed-effects model until three-way interaction
model_780_mcc <- lmer(MCC_z ~ (Grinding + Weighting + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection )^3 + (1|Split), data = lme_780_data)
anova(model_780_mcc)
summary(model_780_mcc)

# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_780_mcc)
r2(model_780_mcc)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_780_mcc <- emmeans(model_780_mcc, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Weighting)
mcc_780_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_780_mcc$emmeans)
mcc_780_pipelines_df <- mcc_780_pipelines_df[order(-mcc_780_pipelines_df$emmean), ]


# Data analysis for F1_Score
# Because F1_Score always between 0 and 1, therefore we cannot use lmer, we need to use glmmTMB with beta distribution
library(glmmTMB)
model_f1_780 <- glmmTMB(F1_score ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Weighting)^2 + (1|Split), data = lme_780_data, family = ordbeta(link = "logit"))
library(car)
Anova(model_f1_780, type = "III")
summary(model_f1_780)
# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_f1_780)
r2(model_f1_780)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_f1_780 <- emmeans(model_f1_780, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Weighting, type = "response")
f1_780_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_f1_780$emmeans)
f1_780_pipelines_df <- f1_780_pipelines_df[order(-f1_780_pipelines_df$response), ]
```
